Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed building sizes, ages, portables, and specialized spaces; robust condition assessment covering HVAC, plumbing, roofs, electrical, lighting, technology infrastructure, and accessibility; detailed cost estimates and prioritization integrating immediate and long-term needs (Chavez Middle School Facilities Needs Spreadsheet, Executive Summary, Facility Assessment sections).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Comprehensive seven-year enrollment projections with detailed methodology including demographic trends, housing development, and mobility factors; capacity utilization data by site and grade; explicit connection of projections to facility actions such as school reconfiguration and program relocation (Demographic Report, Appendices A and D).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with detailed educational specifications; clear integration of district mission, instructional priorities, and facilities planning; comprehensive analysis of facilities supporting multiple programs including TK, CTE, special education, STEM, dual immersion, and collaborative learning; facility projects directly respond to educational goals (Appendix E: Educational Specifications, Educational Program Findings).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Plan provides data and analysis of outdoor spaces including playgrounds, play fields, and gardens; identifies strategies for improvement such as shaded play areas, covered walkways, and outdoor learning environments; references connections between greening and wellness but lacks districtwide detailed data on green surface coverage or stormwater management (Site Plans, Educational Specifications Section 9).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate-related issues such as drainage and flooding in site assessments and community input but lacks detailed climate risk assessment or comprehensive mitigation strategies; climate readiness is mentioned but not a central theme (Facility Assessments, Community Meeting Notes).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Includes energy efficiency strategies such as photovoltaic systems evaluation, HVAC upgrades, and energy management systems; references Title 24 and state goals; discusses energy resilience goals including backup power but lacks comprehensive districtwide energy data and detailed electrification plans (Energy Efficiency and Photovoltaics section, Facility Needs Spreadsheets).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents detailed cost estimates with escalation, contingencies, and soft costs; clear prioritization framework categorizing critical, educational program, and future facility needs; outlines multiple funding strategies including bonds, state grants, and developer fees; considers long-term financial sustainability and aligns financial capacity with educational priorities (Executive Summary, Cost Summaries, Financial Sections).
